review_notes: Read the whole file and the related definitions (modulus, Residues, residueReduction, residueReduction_mk @[simp], residueFourierChar). Grepped the OAI tree for the recurring `Ideal.Quotient.mk (modulus x) x = 0` pattern and for existing simp lemmas about it (none found in CubicGram/Definitions.lean or PrimitiveResidueConductorKernel.lean). The `finiteFourier_translation_support` proof has no simp-interface issue I could justify. Without running Lean, I did not check whether `modulus` unfolding would interfere with the proposed lemma. findings.excerpt:
have hz : Ideal.Quotient.mk (modulus d) d=0 :=
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr (dvd_refl d))
  rw [hz,zero_mul,add_zero]
findings.problem: The file has no simp lemma saying that a generator of the modulus maps to zero in its own residue ring, `Ideal.Quotient.mk (modulus d) d = 0`. The proof therefore proves this fact by hand as a local `hz` and then closes the goal with a manual `rw [hz,zero_mul,add_zero]`. The same local fact is re-proved in many files: CubicThetaWeightFactor, CubicThetaResidueCRT (twice), CubicThetaPrimeCubeFourierKernel, CubicThetaGramSinglePrime, HuxleyLiftedPacking, SquarefreeGauss, PeriodicPoisson, ResiduePoisson (three times) and HuxleyFractionSeparation. In each case the term `mk (modulus d) d * _` is left unsimplified until the user supplies `hz`. The related `mk (modulus q) h = 0 ↔ q ∣ h` equivalence is also rebuilt ad hoc, here at lines 51-52 (via `Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp` and `Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp`) and in CubicThetaPrimeRootHorizontal, CubicThetaPrimeCubeFourierMode and CubicThetaPrimeFourier. `residueReduction_mk` is already @[simp], so a `simp` call would unfold the reduction but still stall on this zero term.
findings.proposed_change: In the file that defines `modulus` and `Residues` (CubicGram/Definitions.lean), or at least in a shared lemma file, add `@[simp] lemma mk_modulus_self (a : Eisenstein) : Ideal.Quotient.mk (modulus a) a = 0` with the proof currently used for `hz`. Also add `lemma mk_modulus_eq_zero_iff {a h : Eisenstein} : Ideal.Quotient.mk (modulus a) h = 0 ↔ a ∣ h`, which can be tagged @[simp]. The tail of `residueFourier_inflation_support` can then be `simp [map_add, map_mul]`, or `rw [map_add, map_mul, residueReduction_mk, mk_modulus_self, zero_mul, add_zero]`. The `q ∣ d*h` conclusion of `residueFourier_reduction_support` can be obtained from `mk_modulus_eq_zero_iff.mp (by rwa [map_mul])`. Each local `hz` in the other files can then be deleted.
findings.benefit: Terms of the form `mk (modulus d) d * x` would normalize to `0` automatically in all these Fourier and residue-ring arguments. The one-line proof would no longer be copied into a dozen files, and `simp only [map_add, map_mul, ...]` calls like those in CubicThetaWeightFactor and CubicThetaResidueCRT could drop the manually supplied `hz`. Readers also get a single named, discoverable statement of the dvd/zero equivalence.
